title: CAST: Causal Advantage-Structured Training with Spatially Grounded Compositional Rewards for Diffusion Models
title_zh: CAST：基于空间化组合奖励的因果优势结构化训练方法（适用于扩散模型）

paragraphs.en: Online reinforcement learning has been successfully extended to flow matching for diffusion model (DM) image generation. However, this paradigm faces three limitations: (1) Window selection. Existing methods typically manually set the stochastic differential equation (SDE) sampling window, i.e. , the denoising steps where exploration noise is injected. We instead determine it from each model’s denoising trajectory. (2) Reward saturation. Current methods rely heavily on scoring models trained on human annotations; we find that such scores are extremely high and nearly indistinguishable on the latest SOTA open-source DMs, making advantage estimation largely ineffective. (3) Sample inefficiency. A single scalar reward collapses different failure modes into almost identical scores, leaving minimal gradient guidance for targeted improvement. To address these issues, we propose CAST ( C ausal A dvantage- S tructured T raining), an RL fine-tuning method for pretrained DMs, which (1) identifies the denoising step at which each model fixes the objects and their spatial arrangement in the image and uses that timing to set the SDE window, (2) decomposes each prompt via Causal Scene Graphs (CSG) into verifiable-atoms , i.e. , minimal semantic units such as an object, count, attribute, or spatial relation that can each be checked independently, and rewards each atom separately, and (3) projects the signed atom-level advantages into pixel space through teacher-forced attention and uses them to spatially weight the SDE policy objective. We fine-tune two of the strongest open-source DMs, FLUX.2-dev and Qwen-Image-2512, with CAST, and evaluate them on GenEval 2, a compositional benchmark on which these models still fail frequently, and on Qwen-Image-Bench for overall quality. Within almost the same training budget, CAST’s improvement over the base model on the most challenging GenEval 2 prompts is up to 3.07 × 3.07\times that of Flow-GRPO, while overall generation quality also improves. Our project page is at https://opencausalab.github.io/CAST .
paragraphs.zh: 在线强化学习已成功扩展至扩散模型（DM）图像生成的流匹配任务中。 然而，这一范式存在三个局限性：（1）窗口选择。 现有方法通常手动设置随机微分方程（SDE）采样窗口，即注入探索噪声的去噪步骤。 我们则根据每个模型的去噪轨迹来确定该窗口。（2）奖励饱和。 当前方法严重依赖基于人类标注训练的评分模型；我们发现，在最新的 SOTA 开源扩散模型上，此类评分极高且几乎无法区分，导致优势估计基本无效。（3）样本效率低下。 单一标量奖励将不同的失败模式坍缩为几乎相同的分数，从而几乎没有梯度指导来实现针对性改进。 为解决这些问题，我们提出了 CAST（因果优势结构化训练），一种针对预训练扩散模型的强化学习微调方法：（1）识别每个模型固定图像中物体及其空间布局的去噪步骤，并利用该时机设置 SDE 窗口；（2）通过因果场景图（CSG）将每个提示分解为可验证原子单元，即最小语义单位（如物体、数量、属性或空间关系），并分别对每个原子单元进行奖励；（3）通过教师强制注意力将带符号的原子级优势投影到像素空间，并利用它们对 SDE 策略目标进行空间加权。 我们使用 CAST 对两个最强的开源扩散模型——FLUX.2-dev 和 Qwen-Image-2512 进行了微调，并在 GenEval 2（这些模型仍频繁失败的组合基准）以及整体质量评估的 Qwen-Image-Bench 上对其进行了测试。 在几乎相同的训练预算下，CAST 在最具挑战性的 GenEval 2 提示上的改进幅度最高可达 Flow-GRPO 的 3.07 × 3.07 倍，同时整体生成质量也得到了提升。 我们的项目页面位于 https://opencausalab.github.io/CAST 。

paragraphs.en: Online reinforcement learning (RL) has proven highly effective at enhancing flow matching for diffusion model (DM) image generation. Flow-GRPO ( Liu et al., 2025 ) converts the deterministic ordinary differential equation (ODE) denoising process into a stochastic differential equation (SDE) with matched marginal distributions and applies online policy gradient optimization, substantially improving image aesthetic quality. Recent extensions ( Savani et al., 2026 ; Deng et al., 2026 ; Tong et al., 2026 ) further introduce per-step rewards, enabling credit assignment along the temporal axis. These advances show that online RL can substantially improve quality when the optimization signal ( Kirstain et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2023 ) is reliable.
paragraphs.zh: 在线强化学习（RL）已被证明在提升扩散模型（DM）图像生成的流匹配效果方面极为有效。 Flow-GRPO（Liu 等，2025）将确定性常微分方程（ODE）的降噪过程转化为具有匹配边缘分布的随机微分方程（SDE），并应用在线策略梯度优化，从而显著提升了图像的审美质量。 近期的扩展研究（Savani 等，2026；Deng 等，2026；Tong 等，2026）进一步引入了每一步的奖励，使得沿时间轴的信用分配成为可能。 这些进展表明，当优化信号可靠时（Kirstain 等，2023；Wu 等，2023），在线强化学习能够显著提升图像质量。

paragraphs.en: First, these methods do not know when to optimize. During denoising, objects and their spatial layout are largely established in the early stages, while the later steps mainly refine low-level visual details ( Choi et al., 2022 ; Hertz et al., 2023 ) . Existing methods adapt optimization across denoising steps using predefined schedules ( Li et al., 2025 ) , timestep-dependent rewards ( Savani et al., 2026 ; Deng et al., 2026 ; Tong et al., 2026 ) , or attention-entropy signals ( Li et al., 2026b ) , but none of them locates the step at which a given model has fixed its layout, although this step differs across models ( Section 3.1 ). We therefore measure, for each model, this transition from layout formation to detail refinement, and use it to set the SDE window where RL exploration takes place.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，这些方法并不知道何时进行优化。 在去噪过程中，物体及其空间布局在很大程度上已在早期阶段确定，而后续步骤主要完善低层视觉细节（Choi et al., 2022；Hertz et al., 2023）。 现有方法通过预定义的时间表（Li et al., 2025）、依赖时间步长的奖励（Savani et al., 2026；Deng et al., 2026；Tong et al., 2026）或注意力-熵信号（Li et al., 2026b）来适应不同去噪步骤的优化，但没有任何一种方法能够确定给定模型已固定其布局的具体步骤，尽管这一步骤在不同模型之间存在差异（第3.1节）。 因此，我们针对每个模型测量从布局形成到细节完善的这一转变过程，并利用它来设定强化学习探索所发生的SDE窗口。

paragraphs.en: Second, current methods rely predominantly on preference models such as PickScore ( Kirstain et al., 2023 ) for reward estimation. On the latest SOTA open-source DMs ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Labs, 2025 ) , we find that preference scores are extremely high and nearly indistinguishable, providing negligible advantage for RL. This calls for structured, verifiable, and discriminative rewards .
paragraphs.zh: 其次，当前方法主要依赖偏好模型（如 PickScore (Kirstain et al., 2023)）进行奖励估计。 在最新的 SOTA 开源 DMs (Wu et al., 2025; Labs, 2025) 上，我们发现偏好分数极高且几乎无法区分，因此对强化学习提供的优势微乎其微。 这要求我们采用结构化、可验证且具有区分能力的奖励机制。

paragraphs.en: Third, a scalar reward collapses different failure modes into almost identical scores, providing little gradient signal for targeted improvement. On GenEval 2 ( Kamath et al., 2025 ) , each prompt decomposes into 3–10 verifiable-atoms (median 6.5), i.e. , minimal, independently verifiable semantic units of a prompt covering object presence, count, attribute, action, and spatial relation. Following the benchmark, we use the term verifiable-atom throughout this paper. A scalar reward, from a preference model or a sum of per-atom rewards, barely reveals which verifiable-atom failed.
paragraphs.zh: 第三，标量奖励将不同的失败模式坍缩为几乎相同的分数，从而无法提供足够的梯度信号以实现有针对性的改进。 在 GenEval 2（Kamath 等人，2025）中，每个提示都会分解为 3–10 个可验证原子（中位数为 6.5），即提示中涵盖对象存在、数量、属性、动作和空间关系的、最小且可独立验证的语义单元。 遵循该基准测试，我们在整篇论文中均使用“可验证原子”这一术语。 无论是来自偏好模型还是各原子奖励之和的标量奖励，几乎都无法揭示究竟是哪个可验证原子出现了问题。

paragraphs.en: These three observations call for two measurements, which our diagnostic experiments ( Section 3 ) provide. To address the first limitation, we use a Tweedie estimate ( Efron, 2011 ) of the clean image at every step to track when objects and their spatial layout become established in each model. To address the second and third, we score each verifiable-atom separately and localize it to specific image pixels via a teacher-forced attention heatmap ( Chefer et al., 2021 ) within a frozen vision-language model (VLM), Qwen3-VL ( Team, 2025 ) , yielding a pixel-level granularity reward .
paragraphs.zh: 这三项观察结果需要两种测量值，而我们的诊断实验（第 3 节）提供了这些测量值。 为了解决第一个局限性，我们在每一步都使用 Tweedie 估计量（Efron, 2011）来估算干净图像，从而追踪物体及其空间布局在每种模型中何时形成稳定状态。 为了解决第二个和第三个局限性，我们分别对每个可验证原子进行评分，并通过冻结的视觉-语言模型（VLM）Qwen3-VL（Team, 2025）中的教师强制注意力热图（Chefer et al., 2021）将其定位到特定的图像像素，从而获得像素级精细度的奖励。

paragraphs.en: Based on this analysis, we propose CAST ( C ausal A dvantage- S tructured T raining), an RL fine-tuning method for pretrained DMs consisting of three stages ( Figure 3 ). (1) CSG probe construction: training prompts are synthesized from Causal Scene Graphs (CSG) ( Yu & Lu, 2025 ) , where every node and edge is paired with a verifiable-atom probe ( Section 4.1 ). (2) Atom-level scoring and grounding: for each group of images sampled within the measured SDE window, the frozen VLM scores each atom independently and locates its evidence through teacher-forced attention ( Section 4.2 ). (3) Spatially weighted optimization: CAST normalizes each atom’s score within the group into an advantage, projects these advantages into a per-pixel advantage map, and uses the map to weight the SDE policy objective ( Section 4.3 ). As illustrated in Figure 1 , CAST produces images that satisfy all verifiable-atoms where existing methods fail.
paragraphs.zh: 基于此分析，我们提出了 CAST（Causal Advantage-Structured Training），一种针对预训练 DM 的强化学习微调方法，包含三个阶段（图 3）。 （1）CSG 探针构建：训练提示由因果场景图（CSG）（Yu & Lu, 2025）合成，其中每个节点和边都与一个可验证原子探针配对（第 4.1 节）。 （2）原子级评分与落地：对于在已测定的 SDE 窗口内采样的每组图像，冻结的 VLM 会独立为每个原子评分，并通过教师强制注意力定位其证据（第 4.2 节）。 （3）空间加权优化：CAST 将组内每个原子的分数归一化为优势值，将这些优势值投影到每像素的优势图中，并利用该图对 SDE 策略目标进行加权（第 4.3 节）。 如图 1 所示，CAST 生成的图像能够满足所有可验证原子，而现有方法则无法做到这一点。

sents.en: (3) Spatially weighted optimization: CAST normalizes each atom’s score within the group into an advantage, projects these advantages into a per-pixel advantage map, and uses the map to weight the SDE policy objective ( Section 4.3 ).

paragraphs.en: We apply CAST to FLUX.2-dev and Qwen-Image-2512, two of the strongest open-source DMs, whose preference scores are already near saturation ( Section 3.2 ); improving them is therefore much harder than improving the weaker models used in earlier diffusion RL work. We evaluate on GenEval 2, which checks every verifiable-atom of compositionally complex prompts, and on Qwen-Image-Bench ( Li et al., 2026a ) , which measures overall generation quality and thus reveals whether compositional gains come at the cost of image quality. The base models already score ≥ 0.95 \geq 0.95 on 11.6 % 11.6\% – 18.8 % 18.8\% of GenEval 2 prompts, leaving no room for improvement there and diluting the full-set average; we therefore focus on a Hard Case subset of prompts on which the base models still fail. On this subset, with the same budget and reward signal, CAST improves over the base model by 1.93 × 1.93\times – 3.07 × 3.07\times as much as Flow-GRPO with a scalar reward, while achieving the best overall quality on Qwen-Image-Bench.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 CAST 应用于 FLUX.2-dev 和 Qwen-Image-2512——两款最强的开源扩散模型，其偏好分数已接近饱和（第 3.2 节）；因此，提升它们的性能比改进早期扩散强化学习研究中使用的较弱模型要困难得多。 我们在 GenEval 2 和 Qwen-Image-Bench（Li et al., 2026a）上进行评估：前者检验了组合结构复杂的提示中每一个可验证的原子要素，后者则衡量整体生成质量，从而揭示组合能力的提升是否以图像质量为代价。 基础模型在 GenEval 2 提示的 11.6%–18.8% 上已得分 ≥0.95，这意味着这些提示已无改进空间，并拉低了全集平均值；因此，我们专注于一个“困难案例”子集，其中基础模型仍存在失败。 在该子集上，在相同预算和奖励信号下，CAST 相较于基础模型的提升幅度是 Flow-GRPO 使用标量奖励时的 1.93–3.07 倍，同时在 Qwen-Image-Bench 上实现了最佳的整体生成质量。

paragraphs.en: We show that preference rewards saturate on strong DMs and that a scalar reward conflates distinct failures; modeling prompts with CSG as separately scored verifiable-atoms restores a discriminative signal that tells the model which part failed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现，在强大的决策模型（DM）上，偏好奖励会达到饱和状态，而标量奖励会将不同的失败情况混为一谈；通过采用可单独评分的可验证原子单元（verifiable-atoms）来以组合结构语法（CSG）建模提示，可以恢复一种区分性信号，从而告诉模型具体是哪一个部分出现了问题。

paragraphs.en: We propose CAST, which applies independently normalized verifiable-atom advantages within a per-model SDE window, so that optimization targets the steps where layout is decided.

paragraphs.en: Current diffusion RL methods rely predominantly on preference models such as PickScore ( Kirstain et al., 2023 ) and HPSv2 ( Wu et al., 2023 ) . paragraphs.en: This result shows that a scalar reward conflates distinct failure modes into nearly identical values. An image with correct objects but incorrect spatial relations and another with correct relations but missing objects may receive the same reward, obscuring which error should be corrected. This limitation is not unique to preference models: although GenEval 2 exposes separate scores for different verifiable-atoms, collapsing them into a single aggregate reward would recreate the same credit-assignment ambiguity. The key issue is therefore not only which evaluator is used, but whether its structured outputs are preserved throughout optimization. Together, these findings motivate three design choices: (1) use the measured transition to set the SDE window, (2) retain independently verifiable atom-level reward factors, and (3) spatially ground each factor in the image regions containing its evidence. We implement all three in CAST .
paragraphs.zh: 这一结果表明，标量奖励会将不同的失败模式混淆为几乎相同的数值。 一个包含正确物体但空间关系错误的图像，与另一个空间关系正确但缺少物体的图像，可能会获得相同的奖励，从而掩盖了究竟应纠正哪种错误。 这种局限性并非偏好模型所独有：尽管 GenEval 2 为不同的可验证原子单元提供了独立的分数，但如果将它们坍缩为一个汇总奖励，就会重现同样的信用分配模糊性。 因此，关键问题不仅在于使用了哪种评估器，更在于其结构化输出是否在优化过程中得到了保留。 综合来看，这些发现促使我们做出三项设计选择：（1）利用测得的转移来设置 SDE 窗口；（2）保留可独立验证的原子级奖励因子；（3）将每个因子在图像中与其证据所在区域进行空间绑定。 我们在 CAST 中实现了这三项设计。

paragraphs.en: The Causal Scene Graph (CSG) ( Yu & Lu, 2025 ) decomposes a text prompt into a directed graph G = ( V , E ) G=(V,E) , where V V represents semantic entities and E E encodes relations among entity pairs. Each node, node attribute, and edge maps to one VQA probe question: (1) node existence → \to object questions; (2) node attributes → \to property questions; (3) edges → \to relational questions. For example, the prompt “four white bicycles in front of three plastic cows” yields nodes {bicycle, cow} with attributes [white, count=4] and [plastic, count=3], and a spatial edge (bicycle → in front of \xrightarrow{\text{in front of}} cow).

paragraphs.en: All trainable methods share a single pool of 1,024 training prompts synthesized by sampling Causal Scene Graphs ( Section 4.1 ): entities endowed with counts and attributes are composed through spatial relations, and the sampled graph is rendered into fluent text. Every node, attribute, and edge is emitted together with its verifiable-atom probe and the words in the prompt, so all K K atoms are fixed by construction before any image is generated. The pool is disjoint from both evaluation benchmarks in exact and normalized form, and all checkpoint and hyperparameter selection uses a held-out 256-prompt development split; the benchmarks are never used for selection.
paragraphs.zh: 所有可训练方法都共享一个由因果场景图（第 4.1 节）采样合成的 1,024 个训练提示词池：具有计数和属性的实体通过空间关系组合而成，而采样出的图会被渲染为流畅的文本。 每个节点、属性和边都会与其可验证原子探针以及提示词中的词语一同输出，因此所有 K 个原子在生成任何图像之前就已经通过构造被固定下来。 该池与精确形式和归一化形式的评估基准完全分离，并且所有检查点和超参数选择都使用一个预留的 256 个提示词的开发集；这些基准从未用于选择过程。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate CAST on FLUX.2-dev ( Labs, 2025 ) and Qwen-Image-2512 ( Wu et al., 2025 ) against Base, two SFT variants, and two Flow-GRPO variants. Base is the unmodified pretrained model. SFT (4/8) and SFT (3/64) are self-distillation baselines: for each pool prompt, the backbone generates 8 (resp. 64) candidates, the frozen verifier scores them under the GenEval 2 protocol, and the four (resp. three) highest-scoring candidates are retained and fine-tuned with uniform weights for three epochs. SFT (3/64) serves as a high-selectivity distillation upper bound. Flow-GRPO ( Liu et al., 2025 ) is evaluated with its original aesthetic reward and an atom-aggregated reward under the GenEval 2 (G2) protocol; both train on-policy on the same pool.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 FLUX.2-dev（Labs，2025）和 Qwen-Image-2512（Wu 等人，2025）上，将 CAST 与 Base、两种 SFT 变体以及两种 Flow-GRPO 变体进行了对比评估。 Base 是未经修改的预训练模型。 SFT（4/8）和 SFT（3/64）是自蒸馏基线：对于每个池提示，主干模型会生成 8 个（或 64 个）候选结果，冻结的验证器根据 GenEval 2 协议对其进行评分，然后保留得分最高的四个（或三个）候选结果，并以均匀权重进行三轮微调。 SFT（3/64）作为高选择性的蒸馏上限。 Flow-GRPO（Liu 等人，2025）使用其原始美学奖励和基于原子聚合的奖励，在 GenEval 2（G2）协议下进行评估；两者均在同一池上执行在线策略训练。

paragraphs.en: Although GenEval 2 is far more discriminative than preference rewards in aggregate ( Section 3.2 ), a nontrivial fraction of its prompts is already saturated even for the untrained base models: averaged over the four evaluation seeds, the per-prompt Overall score is ≥ 0.95 \geq 0.95 on 150 of 800 prompts (18.8%) for FLUX.2-dev and 93 of 800 (11.6%) for Qwen-Image-2512. Near-ceiling prompts contribute almost identical scores to every method, so the full-set average understates the remaining differences. We therefore report a 50-prompt Hard Case subset alongside the full-set average: the frozen FLUX.2-dev base model generates 64 images per evaluation prompt, the frozen verifier scores them for subset selection only, and we retain the 100 highest-variance prompts before keeping the 50 with the lowest mean score ( Appendix G ).
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 GenEval 2 的整体区分能力远优于偏好奖励（第 3.2 节），但其提示中仍有相当一部分即使对于未经训练的基模型也已达到饱和状态：在四个评估种子中取平均值，FLUX.2-dev 有 800 个提示中的 150 个（18.8%）以及 Qwen-Image-2512 有 93 个（11.6%）的每个提示“总体得分”≥ 0.95。 接近上限的提示为所有方法贡献的分数几乎完全相同，因此完整数据集的平均值会低估其余模型之间的差异。 因此，我们在报告完整数据集平均值的同时，还报告了一个包含 50 个提示的“困难案例”子集：冻结的 FLUX.2-dev 基模型为每个评估提示生成 64 张图像，冻结的验证器仅用于对子集进行评分，随后我们保留方差最高的 100 个提示，并从中选择平均得分最低的 50 个提示（附录 G）。

paragraphs.en: Flow-GRPO with its original preference reward provides no consistent improvement over the base models, while selective-distillation SFT yields only modest gains despite using up to 32 × 32\times more generated images. Replacing the aesthetic reward with the aggregated GenEval 2 reward makes Flow-GRPO improve on both backbones and provides the matched-reward reference for CAST. These full-set averages, however, compress the differences on the 11.6 % 11.6\% – 18.8 % 18.8\% of evaluation prompts that are already saturated for the base models ( Section 5.2 ); we therefore focus on the Hard Case subset, with full-set scores reported in Table 1 . paragraphs.en: DDPO ( Black et al., 2024 ) formulated diffusion denoising as a multi-step MDP with terminal rewards. Flow-GRPO ( Liu et al., 2025 ) then extended GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) to flow matching by converting the deterministic ODE into an equivalent SDE for stochastic exploration. Later methods improved temporal credit assignment through per-step reward gains ( Savani et al., 2026 ) or adaptive timestep-wise stochasticity ( Deng et al., 2026 ) . Neighbor GRPO ( He et al., 2025 ) instead retained deterministic ODE sampling and perturbed only the initial noise. CAST complements temporal credit assignment with spatial credit assignment: each atom advantage weights the corresponding evidence region within a calibrated early SDE window.
paragraphs.zh: DDPO（Black 等人，2024）将扩散去噪建模为具有终端奖励的多步马尔可夫决策过程。 Flow-GRPO（Liu 等人，2025）随后将 GRPO（Shao 等人，2024）扩展到流匹配方法中，通过将确定性常微分方程转换为等价的随机微分方程以实现随机探索。 后续方法通过每步奖励增益（Savani 等人，2026）或自适应的时间步随机性（Deng 等人，2026）改进了时间上的信用分配。 Neighbor GRPO（He 等人，2025）则保留了确定性常微分方程的采样方式，仅对初始噪声进行扰动。 CAST 将时间上的信用分配与空间上的信用分配相结合：每个原子的优势值会对校准后的早期随机微分方程窗口内对应的证据区域进行加权。

paragraphs.en: TIFA ( Hu et al., 2023 ) evaluates prompt alignment using VQA questions generated from the prompt, while VQAScore ( Lin et al., 2024 ) uses a single global question. GenEval 2 ( Kamath et al., 2025 ) provides a finer decomposition by evaluating prompt atoms across object, count, attribute, spatial relation, and verb skills. paragraphs.en: Preference models such as PickScore ( Kirstain et al., 2023 ) , ImageReward ( Xu et al., 2023 ) , and HPSv2 ( Wu et al., 2023 ) provide scalar rewards for diffusion-model training. MPS ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) decomposes preference into several dimensions, but each remains a global score without spatial localization. VisionReward ( Xu et al., 2026 ) uses fine-grained VQA questions, but likewise produces only a scalar score for each question. Focus-N-Fix ( Xing et al., 2025 ) localizes problematic regions for region-aware fine-tuning, but uses a single global heatmap, whereas CAST pairs every atom advantage with its own map.

paragraphs.en: We introduce CAST , which trains diffusion models with spatially grounded atom-level rewards. Our diagnostics show that strong DMs fix their layout early, that preference rewards saturate on them, and that a scalar reward conflates distinct failures. CAST therefore sets a model-specific early SDE window, computes a separate advantage for each verifiable-atom, and projects it via teacher-forced attention onto its image region to weight the policy objective. On two strong DMs, CAST improves adherence on the hardest GenEval 2 prompts well beyond Flow-GRPO at equal budget while preserving overall quality, enabling finer-grained credit assignment than a scalar reward.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 CAST，它利用具有空间基准的原子级奖励来训练扩散模型。 我们的诊断结果表明，强大的扩散模型会早期确定其布局，偏好奖励在这些模型上会达到饱和，而标量奖励会将不同的失败情况混为一谈。 因此，CAST 为每个模型设定了一个特定的早期 SDE 窗口，为每个可验证的原子计算独立的优势值，并通过教师强制注意力将其投影到对应的图像区域，从而对策略目标进行加权。 在两个强大的扩散模型上，CAST 在相同预算下显著提升了其对最困难 GenEval 2 提示的遵循度，远超 Flow-GRPO，同时保持了整体质量，并实现了比标量奖励更精细的功劳分配。

paragraphs.en: Each of the 1,024 training prompts is synthesized by sampling a Causal Scene Graph ( Section 4.1 ): entities endowed with counts and attributes are composed through spatial relations, and the sampled graph is rendered into fluent text. Every node, attribute, and edge is emitted together with its verifiable-atom probe and the words in the prompt, so all K K atoms are fixed by construction before any image is generated. The pool mirrors the compositional structure that GenEval 2-style prompts instantiate, yet is generated from scratch: it is disjoint from the 800 GenEval 2 and 1,000 Qwen-Image-Bench evaluation prompts in both exact and normalized form. All checkpoint and hyperparameter selection uses a held-out set of 256 development prompts from the same construction; the benchmarks are never used for selection. Each RL method runs 128 single-prompt collections with group size 16, matching its 2,048 generated images and 128 optimizer updates (Table 1 (b)).
paragraphs.zh: 1,024个训练提示中的每一个都是通过采样因果场景图（第4.1节）合成的：具有计数和属性的实体通过空间关系组合而成，而采样得到的图会被渲染为流畅的文本。 每个节点、属性和边都会与其可验证原子探针以及提示中的词语一同输出，因此所有K个原子在生成任何图像之前就已经被确定下来。 该池反映了GenEval 2风格提示所体现的组合结构，但却是从头生成的：它在精确形式和归一化形式上均与800个GenEval 2评估提示和1,000个Qwen-Image-Bench评估提示完全无关。 所有检查点和超参数选择都使用来自相同构建过程的256个预留开发提示集；这些基准测试从未被用于选择过程。 每种强化学习方法都会运行128次单提示收集，每组大小为16，这与它生成的2,048张图像和128次优化器更新相匹配（表1(b)）。

paragraphs.en: We analyze the pre-projection attention-head activations of FLUX.2-dev on 10 hard GenEval 2 prompts with 64 generated images per prompt. This diagnostic is not used by CAST during training. We record activations from all 56 transformer blocks at denoising steps 3, 7, 14, and 21. For each verifiable atom, we measure the normalized difference between the mean activations of correct and incorrect images, then aggregate the results by count, attribute, and spatial relation. We estimate significance with 200 label permutations, combine evidence across prompts with Fisher’s method, and apply Benjamini–Hochberg FDR correction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分析了 FLUX.2-dev 在 10 个具有挑战性的 GenEval 2 提示词上的预投影注意力头激活值，每个提示词生成 64 张图像。 CAST 在训练过程中不会使用这种诊断方法。 我们在去噪步骤 3、7、14 和 21 时记录了所有 56 个变换器块的激活值。 对于每个可验证的原子单元，我们测量正确图像与错误图像的平均激活值之间的归一化差异，然后按数量、属性和空间关系对结果进行汇总。 我们通过 200 次标签排列来估计显著性，使用费舍尔方法整合不同提示词的证据，并应用 Benjamini–Hochberg FDR 校正。

paragraphs.en: Figure 8 shows different temporal patterns across the three skills. Spatial relation is most sensitive at the early step and then declines; attribute becomes broadly sensitive from step 7 onward; and count is most clearly separated at step 7. paragraphs.en: Averaged over the four evaluation seeds, the per-prompt GenEval 2 Overall score of the untrained base models is ≥ 0.95 \geq 0.95 on 150 of 800 prompts (18.8%) for FLUX.2-dev and 93 of 800 (11.6%) for Qwen-Image-2512. To construct the subset, the frozen FLUX.2-dev base model generates 64 images for each of the 800 evaluation prompts, and the frozen verifier scores them under the GenEval 2 protocol; these scores serve for subset selection only. We first retain the 100 prompts with the highest within-prompt score variance, which discards both saturated prompts (consistently correct) and uninformative ones (consistently incorrect), and then keep the 50 with the lowest mean score among them. The subset is fixed before training, involves no trained method, and is shared by all methods on both backbones.
paragraphs.zh: 在四个评估种子中取平均值后，未经训练的基模型在每个提示下的 GenEval 2 综合得分，对于 FLUX.2-dev 的 800 个提示中有 150 个（18.8%）≥ 0.95 \geq 0.95，而对于 Qwen-Image-2512 则有 93 个（11.6%）。 为了构建该子集，冻结的 FLUX.2-dev 基模型为 800 个评估提示中的每个提示生成 64 张图像，并由冻结的验证器根据 GenEval 2 协议进行评分；这些评分仅用于子集的选择。 我们首先保留提示内得分方差最高的 100 个提示，这会排除饱和提示（始终正确）和无信息提示（始终错误），然后从中保留平均分最低的 50 个提示。 该子集在训练前就已确定，不涉及任何训练方法，并且所有方法在两种骨干网络上均共享该子集。
